title: fix: stop retrying Tinybird event payloads
author: voodoohop
pr_body_excerpt:
- Sends each Tinybird generation-event payload exactly once at the application level, including on 5xx, 429, and network failures.
- Removes exponential backoff and retry state from the shared sender used by generation, realtime, and MCP tracking.
- Removes the usage-history full-window aggregation and read-time deduplication; historical rows are returned as stored.
- The direct 30-day production query completed in 0.03s / 95k rows read, versus 15.9s / 11.3M rows for the previous aggregation.
- Adds regression tests for failed HTTP responses and network errors; each asserts one fetch call.
- Tests: `npm run test -- test/events.test.ts test/account-usage.test.ts test/account-key-usage.test.ts` (17/17).
- Requires normal staging-first Tinybird rollout and the standard Cloudflare deployment after merge; no deployment was performed.

gist.headline: One event, one flight
gist.blurb: The event courier has stopped circling the same flower. Generation, realtime, and MCP tracking now send each Tinybird payload once, while usage history reads the rows already in the garden at a much healthier pace.
gist.summary: Tinybird generation-event delivery now makes exactly one application-level send attempt across generation, realtime, and MCP tracking, and usage-history queries now return stored rows directly instead of full-window aggregation and read-time deduplication.
gist.impact: Usage history can read a 30-day, 95k-row production window in 0.03 seconds instead of 15.9 seconds over 11.3M aggregated rows, with event sends no longer repeated after 5xx, 429, or network responses.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy mail-and-garden metaphor for exactly-once event delivery and faster history lookup: Polli carries one sealed pollen packet to a Tinybird-inspired data garden while a retro terminal displays a short, tidy row of stored records rather than a tangled pile of duplicate scrolls. Include code-plants and a small stopwatch to represent the 0.03-second query, with Polli wearing a tiny courier cap.
